summary: Mishra wants AI for biology to move faster, sees fears about AI as hypotheticals beside real disease and says biology, not compute, limits cures.

statements.quote: They go into hypotheticals. Because hypotheticals about AI are less scary than their own mortality.
I’d rather live with an unpredictable, powerful force that I can use to do good. That, over living with the real devil that is chronic disease.
Can we see ASI as something we are shaping with our actions? The ASI I am shaping cures diseases and defends against biological threats and toxins.
Everyone is freaking out about AI safety. I think we are going way wayyyy too slow
80% of cure discovery is not compute accelerated. That 80% is the biology.
